newsitem.title: UK: Both Brent dates kept - traders.
newsitem.headline: Both Brent dates kept - traders.

text.p: The two Brent cargoes nominated from the paper chains on Tuesday were both kept ahead of the five o'clock deadline, traders said.
The cargoes, loading Feb 12-14, were kept by Stasco, they said.
Brent cargoes are traded on a paper, or forward, market until the 1700 London time deadline on the nearest trading day 15 days before their assigned loading date.
A trading company is five o'clocked when they are left with a paper cargo which has turned physical after that deadline and thus cannot be passed on as part of a chain of pre-sold paper cargo deals.
